title: The Torn Page
synopsis: Today the library will show the notebook of Eleanor Hart, a toymaker from 1926.
Its last page is the first clue to her hidden Silver Lark.
But this morning, the last page is gone.
goal: Find out when the page went missing, and where Eleanor's trail begins.

options.label: A small light moved in the hall.
The alarm rang in the hall.
options.feedback: Nobody talked about an alarm. Find two people who say the same thing.

options.label: Nothing happened at ten.
options.feedback: Dr. Brooks was at home. What did Frank and Sam see?

notes: Played as a talk (DialogueScene) in the exhibit hall: Frank (inside) and Sam (outside, by the window) both saw a small light move in the hall at ten.
Sam's answer to 'Where were you at ten?' (a man with a black bag came out of the side door) is heard after the deduction (then): paid off in Case 07 and Case 11.

learning.objective: 세 사람에게 같은 질문을 하고, 밤 10시에 대해 두 사람이 같은 것을 본 진술(a small light)을 찾는다.
expressions: What did you see at ten?
A small light moved in the hall.

play.title: The Night at the Library
story: Dr. Harold Brooks meets you by an empty glass case.
"The last page of Eleanor's notebook is gone!" he says.
Three people can tell you about last night.
play.letter:
Ask each person what they saw.
Find two people who say the same thing about ten o'clock.
play.question: What happened in the exhibit hall at ten?
hints: Ask every person the same question: What did you see at ten?
Two people saw the same thing. One was inside, one was outside.
play.successMessage: Two witnesses saw the same thing!
transition: At ten, someone was in the dark hall with a small light.
And a man with a black bag left by the side door.
Frank hands you his night log.

play.title: The 1926 Newspaper
story: Next to the notebook lies an old newspaper page.
It is yellow and very thin.
Maya Chen, a young librarian, reads it with you.
play.letter:
TOYMAKER HIDES A SINGING BIRD
Miss Eleanor Hart has made a silver bird that sings.
She calls it the Silver Lark.
She has hidden it in New York for a child of the city.
"My notebook's last page is the first clue," she says.
"Each clue is kept by a friend of the city.
Each friend will ask one question.
Only a careful reader can answer it."
play.question: How can you get each clue on the Lark's trail?
hints: Read what Eleanor says about her friends.
What will each friend do when you come?
transition: Each friend of the Lark asks one question.
"The Lark was never found," says Dr. Brooks.

clue.title: Eleanor's Rule
clue.note: Eleanor gave each clue to a friend of the city. Only a careful reader can get it.

discovery.title: A BIRD FOR A CHILD
discovery.detail: Eleanor hid the Lark for a child who reads carefully. Now it is worth a fortune.

Look up: its stars are painted backwards.
Ask the Lost and Found for the Lark's egg.
— E. H.

play.title: The Night in Order
story: You sit on the steps between the two stone lions.
A thin strip of the page is still in the notebook. Its edge is a zigzag with three points.
"Let's put last night in order," Maya says.
play.letter:
Frank saw the page on his round three hours after Dr. Brooks locked the case.
The small light moved in the hall one hour after Frank's round.
Sam saw the man with the black bag five minutes after the light.
The library opens at ten the next morning.
play.question: Put last night in order, from first to last. When was the page taken?
hints: Find the first thing: everything else comes after it.
The library opening is the next morning. Is it part of the night?
play.successMessage: Now you know when the page was taken!
transition: Between nine and ten past ten, the page was taken.
Then the thief left by the side door with a black bag.
Suddenly, a TV van stops by the lions.
play.orderFeedback: Find what came first. Then read 'after' in each line.

intro: New York. Yellow taxis, tall towers and noisy streets.
Today the New York Public Library shows an old notebook.
It belonged to Eleanor Hart, a toymaker, in 1926.
But the notebook's last page is gone!
play.caseSummary: The page was safe at nine. At ten, Frank and Sam saw a light in the hall. A man with a black bag left at 10:05. Eleanor's rule: each friend asks one question. Maya's rubbing sent you to the great hall of trains.

notes: Season 4 (New York), planned by Claude Code with tool/season_planner/PLAYBOOK.md.
The page stub (s4_ep01_e4) with its three-point zigzag pays off in Case 11, where the cut page is found in Dexter's studio. Sam's man with a black bag pays off in Case 07 and Case 11.
